newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil inmates kill two, hold four wardens hostage.
newsitem.headline: Brazil inmates kill two, hold four wardens hostage.

text.p: Brazilian inmates killed two prisoners and held four wardens hostage in the third day of a Sao Paulo state prison revolt, police said on Monday.
A police spokesman said the rebellion at the maximum security prison in Praia Grande, 75 miles (120 kms) south of Sao Paulo, began on Saturday after a failed prisoner escape attempt.
He said 490 inmates had taken control of the prison and were sitting on the roof of one of its wings.
The two inmates were killed and thrown to the ground from a height of 33 feet (10 metres).
The inmates, most of whom are awaiting trial, have demanded that prisoners who have already been sentenced be transferred to another prison.
Hardly a week goes by without some kind of trouble in Brazil's overcrowded prison system where rebellions, murder and abuse by authorities are routine, human rights activists say.
